method: Use pinned upstream equal-alternative opportunity convention. Independently enumerate opportunities with Biopython; verify every sense-codon S/NS opportunity in HyPhy for both codes. Read all saved equilibrium-frequency vectors and verify frequency-weighted S/NS independently in a fresh HyPhy process for every fit. Normalize all audited branch components. Use the isolated stop-compaction correction, not the defective original helper.
interpretation: Derived branch distances under an explicit upstream site-opportunity convention. No new optimization, saturation threshold, time calibration, branch-specific omega or selection test. Normalized dN/dS need not equal fitted omega because opportunity counting does not use the fitted mutation-rate weights.
cost: Existing authorized local host; no new charges
